note: BUMPED to 1.0.11 from 1.0.10. THE TRANSCRIPTION, THE SECTION MODEL AND THE ANCHORS ARE UNCHANGED: source.txt is byte-identical to 1.0.10's (sha256 748e58cef10981193585a101fcf67951cc3a37577eaf756f08399e343e1dd8bf), and divisions.json and base.json are carried unchanged. TWO KINDS OF CHANGE, neither of them the text of the print. (1) THE EVIDENCE LEAF OF 112 RULES IS RE-CITED. The leaf table that named them began each printed page inside the PREVIOUS page's tail, so every rule standing in that tail was cited one leaf too high; seven rules 1.0.9 moved the other way are moved back. The true leaf is not an inference: the scanned item's own per-leaf text layer (thomastaylor _djvu.xml) IS this edition's transcription (MEASURED: all 28,444 non-empty source lines equal the first 28,444 non-empty leaf lines, in order, 0 mismatches), so which leaf a line stands on is the layer's own page element. NOT ONE OF THE 112 RULES' READINGS CHANGES; only the citation moves. (2) TEN READINGS ARE CORRECTED, each withdrawn and its corrected reading appended under a fresh id (r11902-r11911). Seven were serving the reading of a DIFFERENT PRINTED LINE than the one their `find` fires on — the served reading view carried the verses of this hymn permuted, and one running head carried another page's. Three were misreadings of the line they do fire on. Every correction was decided on instruments independent of the rule: a blind full-page transcription of the plate (no candidate text shown), the human-proofread Project Gutenberg transcription of the same 1816 print, the two other scans of vol. I (their own _djvu.xml, which keep punctuation and case), and the letter-for-letter correspondence between the rule's own garbled `find` and the reading it claims. 1.0.11 carries 3255 rules: 1.0.10's 3,255 less the ten withdrawn ids plus the ten fresh ids that replace them. source.txt, divisions.json and base.json are carried unchanged, so NOT ONE DIVISION OR ANCHOR MOVES. 112 rules' EVIDENCE LEAF is re-cited (and their `witness` and `rationale` with it) because the leaf table named the wrong page: NOT ONE OF THOSE READINGS CHANGES. Ten readings ARE corrected, each with its instruments named in its own rationale.
